reviews.author: Thomas King
reviews.text:
I just bought an Evolution cart from Eluxen Carts and couldn't be happier. Nick was amazing to work with. He was knowledgeable and patient, and he made the whole process easy. He helped me fully kit out the cart with everything I wanted, and it turned out exactly how I pictured it.

Communication was excellent the whole way through. Nick kept me updated and made coordinating delivery simple and stress-free. It's rare to find this level of customer service these days.
